assumptions.choice: Support = lowest low, resistance = highest high, over the 20 bars strictly preceding the current bar (bt.indicators.Lowest/Highest applied to low(-1)/high(-1))
assumptions.reason: Spec says 'local lows/highs over the last 20 bars'; excluding the current bar from the extremum calculation is necessary so the current bar can meaningfully 'touch or break' a pre-existing level rather than always defining it by construction.

assumptions.choice: Engulfing = current body fully contains prior opposite-colored body (open/close cross); hammer/hanging-man = same shape check (lower shadow >= 2x body, upper shadow <= 1x body), reused for both bullish (at support) and bearish (at resistance) context since hammer and hanging man are visually identical candles distinguished only by context
assumptions.reason: Spec names these patterns as examples but gives no numeric thresholds; standard technical-analysis definitions were used.

assumptions.choice: Use the signal bar's close price as the assumed entry price when computing the take-profit target and the risk-based position size
assumptions.reason: Orders submitted in next() fill at the next bar's open under the default broker, so the true fill price is unknown at submission time; the signal bar's close is the closest available literal proxy.

assumptions.choice: 1% of current portfolio value risked per trade
assumptions.reason: Spec states a range of '1-2%' without pinning an exact value; 1% was chosen as the conservative bound of the stated range.

assumptions.choice: Take-profit checked via intrabar high (long) / low (short) touching the target; stop-loss checked via bar close, per the spec's explicit 'closes a bar below/above' wording
assumptions.reason: Spec explicitly ties the stop-loss to a bar close but is silent on how the take-profit distance is detected; intrabar touch is the standard reading of 'price moves a distance ... from the entry point'.

assumptions.choice: 4H trend filter approximated by manually aggregating the single provided 1H feed into synthetic 4H closes (every 4 bars) inside the strategy, then comparing the latest synthetic close to a 20-period SMA of synthetic closes to classify bullish/bearish
assumptions.reason: The harness supplies only one 1H PandasData feed with cerebro setup fixed externally; a genuine resampled 4H data feed cannot be added by the strategy itself, so an in-strategy manual aggregation is the closest literal implementation of a 'higher timeframe trend' check.
